query: Self-Refine 的核心贡献是什么？
answer: Self-Refine 的核心贡献是提出一种无需监督训练数据、额外训练或强化学习的方法：先用同一个大语言模型生成初始输出，再由该模型对自己的输出提供反馈并据此迭代改进，从而提升初始输出质量。
support_quote: SELF-REFINE does not require any supervised training data, additional training, or reinforcement learning, and instead uses a single LLM as the generator, refiner, and feedback provider.
title: Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback

query: Self-Refine 在评估中使用了哪些指标？
answer: Self-Refine 报告三类指标：任务特定指标（如数学推理的求解率、代码优化的程序优化百分比）、以 GPT-4 作为人类偏好代理的 GPT-4-pref，以及人类偏好指标 human-pref。
support_quote: We report three types of metrics: • Task specific metric: When available, we use automated metrics from prior work (Math Reasoning: % solve rate; Code Optimization: % programs optimized%).
title: Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback

query: Self-Refine 中反馈质量对结果有什么影响？
answer: 具体、可操作的反馈很重要：没有可操作反馈时，模型往往重复相同输出或做无关修改；在 Acronym Generation 中，没有可操作反馈时即使迭代改进，性能也从 56.4 降到 48.0。
support_quote: Similarly, in Acronym Generation, without actionable feedback, performance drops from 56.4 to 48.0, even with iterative refinements.
title: Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback

query: Self-Refine 在 Vicuna-13B 上的表现如何？
answer: Vicuna-13B 能生成初始输出，但在改进过程中明显吃力：它无法稳定按所需格式生成反馈，即使给出 Oracle 或硬编码反馈，也常常不遵循改进提示，而是重复原输出或生成幻觉对话。
support_quote: Specifically, Vicuna-13B was not able to consistently generate the feedback in the required format. Furthermore, even when provided with Oracle or hard-coded feedback, it often failed to adhere to the prompts for refinement.
title: Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback

query: Self-Refine 与强化学习类方法在是否更新模型参数上有何不同？
answer: Self-Refine 不更新模型参数；而文中提到的强化学习方法需要更新模型参数。
support_quote: Second, these RL methods require updating the model’s parameters, unlike SELF-REFINE.
title: Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback
